summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. (CPAC), a Peruvian cement producer listed via a US Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a current report), disclosed correspondence between valuation firm MSRA S.A.C. and Peru's SMV regulator regarding the minimum reference price for a public tender offer (PTO) by Inversiones Aspi S.A. The October 14, 2026 valuation fixes the minimum consideration at S/ 8.93 per common share under the consideration-value methodology; MSRA's October 30 reply addresses SMV observations without changing that price. The board makes no recommendation, the offeror sets price, and the Aspi bid remains pending SMV review before launch. Watch regulatory clearance, final launch price and premium to market, and tender acceptance versus the Aspi stake threshold.
